reasons: The cited clause matches the preferred position on every material term: once per twelve months, 30 days' prior written notice, normal business hours, off-site where practicable, independent auditor bound by confidentiality (p0082).

Cost allocation sits with Vendor unless underpayment exceeds five percent, and direct access to Customer systems/unrelated Customer Data is expressly barred (p0083), so no walk-away trigger is present.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or comment was proposed and the rendered text is unchanged; deterministic check on audit frequency passes.
Rationale accurately describes the clause and correctly notes that Section 22.3 adds Customer-favourable protections that should not be flagged.
